events_detected.title: US-Iran trade strikes first time in a month: US hits Larak Island launchers; supertanker mined in southern Hormuz; Iran missiles at 2 US bases in Jordan; Kharg claimed hit
events_detected.description: US airstrikes Aug 30 on IRGC rocket launchers on Larak Island (IRGC observed preparing rocket-mines for Hormuz). Aug 31: IRGC reports supertanker struck two naval mines in southern strait, caught fire, halted; IRGC warns other ships. Iran attacked 2 US airbases in Jordan with ballistic missiles ('heavy damage'; Jordan intercepted 8). Iran targeted US personnel at UAE airbase (UAE says missile claim unfounded). Trump claims Kharg Island 'being blown to smithereens'. Supreme Leader Khamenei message 6 months after war start.
events_detected.source: The Guardian (live, Aug 31), Britannica, Crisis Group, CFR
events_detected.trend_change: WORSE - escalation from economic/sanctions framing back to direct kinetic exchange; tanker mining re-imposes shipping risk premium

events_detected.title: US Treasury sovereign bond intervention ongoing - bonds retreated from rally, long-end yields near 2-decade highs, Fed (Warsh) hawkish, >70% odds of Fed HIKE by Dec
events_detected.description: Bessent's long-dated buyback (CNBC: could tap ~$1T Treasury General Account) announced ~Aug 21-24. Bonds retreated from initial rally - yields HIGHER amid skepticism (Evercore: 'weak form of Operation Twist'; JPMorgan: buyback 'belies underlying structural challenges'). AI-driven corporate bond supply pressuring long end. Warsh at Jackson Hole: inflation not slowing. Wall Street war-gaming shift to bills/short-maturity issuance. Treasury-Fed collision course.
events_detected.source: CNBC (Aug 24, Aug 26), TechTimes, TradingView, Yahoo Finance, LATimes, TipsWatch
events_detected.trend_change: WORSE - intervention failing to hold (yields back up), Fed-Treasury friction now open at Jackson Hole, hike repricing

events_detected.title: Yen intervention erased: USD/JPY closed 160.10, breached 160 again Aug 31; JGB 10Y fresh 30-yr high 2.95%; traders on intervention watch
events_detected.description: Aug 1 joint US-Japan intervention (MOF confirmed; US Treasury ESF swap) pushed yen to ~155 lows. Aug 28 close 160.10 - all gains erased (UniCredit: FX intervention cannot fix fundamentals). Aug 31 intraday breach of 160 again after Warsh hawkish tone; Bloomberg: traders on intervention watch. JGB 10Y 2.95% = 30-yr high; strain risk for Japanese banks/insurers holding older low-yield bonds. Bessent letter warns yen volatility spillover risk to global markets.
events_detected.source: Bloomberg (Aug 31), Japan Times (Aug 29), investinglive, exchangerates.org.uk, Atlas Institute
events_detected.trend_change: WORSE - intervention fully reversed; 160 broken again; second intervention likely

events_detected.title: Niger coup attempt Aug 29: mutinous soldiers vs President Tiani, gunfire at presidential palace; Moody's cuts Senegal to Caa2 (near default)
events_detected.description: Aug 29: attempted coup in Niamey - gunfire/explosions near airport, Presidential Palace, ORTN HQ. Outcome uncertain in sources. Separately Moody's downgraded Senegal Aug 28 (Caa1 -> Caa2) on executive-legislature power rift amid debt crisis.
events_detected.trend_change: NEW - Sahel instability continues; Niger hosts US/Russia military presence dynamics, uranium supply

events_detected.title: UK 10Y gilt >5% held all month; BoE urged to halt QT as borrowing costs climb; BoE backstop for systemic stablecoin issuers
events_detected.description: Gilt yields ~5.01% sustained through August (Truss-era territory), roughly 0.3pp above comparable US paper. Investors/analysts urge BoE to stop active bond sales, costing Treasury billions. BoE confirmed central bank liquidity facility (backstop) for systemic stablecoin issuers against gilt holdings.
events_detected.source: FXStreet (Aug 24), Investing.com, Scottish Financial News, OMFIF
